description: Collect frame health, memory diagnostics, and platform profiling artifacts with compact agent-readable summaries. For CPU profiles, start and stop write the raw artifact while report writes a compact summary; request the report when the task needs readable native CPU evidence. Profiling output is evidence only: compact state, artifact path, and size. Times out after 90s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

template.description: xctrace template name, for example Time Profiler.

tracePath.description: Existing .trace path to report, defaults to the latest session trace.

name: perf
